To Enable "Permanent Learning" (Optional)
Just like with Glitch, if you want Sage to remember your project details forever:
Create a Google Doc named Sage_Architecture_Log.
Upload it to the Gem's Knowledge.
Tell Sage: "Review the Architecture Log before answering."
When you make a major decision, say: "Sage, generate a summary of this decision for the Log." Copy-paste his summary back into your Doc
Just another form of memory stuff for right now but if I was to take your keep notes after they build up a little bit and put them all in there I can put them in a document like put that in the stuff you're supposed to know your knowledge base.
